page.overview:
What is Celduin?

Celduin, the Running River or River Running, was a long river in the region of Rhovanion that flowed from Erebor through the Long Lake and down to the inland Sea of Rhûn.

Celduin was a six hundred mile long river and through the eastern outskirts of Mirkwood, then south-east through some uninhabited regions of Rhovanion to its confluence with Carnen and finally in a long south-eastward loop to the great inland Sea of Rhûn, past Dorwinion.

Celduin had three tributaries: the Forest River, which flowed into the Long Lake from the west; a small unnamed river that flowed from the Mountains of Mirkwood to join Celduin just north of Menn-i-Naugrim;

In the thirteenth century of the Third Age, Celduin had formed the north-east border of the lands of Vidugavia. During the Great Plague in the year 1636, more than half of the people of Rhovanion died and, when the Wainriders invaded from the east in the year 1851, After the threat of the Wainriders ended, some of the Northmen went back to the banks of Celduin. When Cirion became the Steward of Gondor he learned that new Easterlings were again driving the remnant of the Northmen up Celduin.
